events.label: The Start of the Kali Yuga
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: Puranic reckoning counts the Kali Yuga from this year, after the Dvapara Yuga ends. Other schools use different cycles and dates. The game treats it as a story setting.

events.label: The Buddha
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: Siddhartha Gautama taught in the Ganga plain. Scholars disagree by several decades about his dates. The game only names him and shows no one.

events.label: Mahavira
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: Mahavira is honoured as the last teacher of the Jain tradition of this age. His dates differ between sources. The game only names him and shows no one.

events.label: Alexander in the Punjab
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A Macedonian army crossed into the Punjab and fought at the Hydaspes river. The date is from general knowledge and was not checked here.

events.label: The Mauryan Empire
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A large empire ruled from Pataliputra, with a wide road network. The dates are approximate and were not checked here.

events.label: The Night Report of Pataliputra
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: On a monsoon night you carry a ferry clerk's report past a doubled watch to a sluice house. The secret is only a jammed sluice and a rising river. Ease the watch's eyes, never fight.

events.label: Pataliputra's Timber Wall
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: Megasthenes wrote of a wooden wall and a wide ditch. His book is lost and survives through later writers. Waddell found timber palisade remains near Patna in 1892-1899 CE.

events.label: The Arthashastra
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A text on statecraft traditionally credited to Kautilya, with a chapter on spies. Its author and date are disputed. The game borrows only a mood.

events.label: Ashokan Edicts
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: Edicts carved on rock and pillars speak of wells dug and trees planted along roads. The date comes from a summary and no translation was read.

events.label: Sangam Literature
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: Early Tamil poems of the south sing of harbours, hills and trade. Scholars date them differently. The next level borrows only the setting.

events.label: The Hill Stream and the Harbour Road
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A swollen stream and a rope bridge stand between a caravan and the harbour. Learn to use a staff to steady and to guide. Collect the pepper sacks before the tide.

events.label: Silambam
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A staff art of Tamil country, named after the silambu bamboo. Sources say it is old, but the exact age is not agreed. No move is copied in the game.

events.label: The Gupta Age
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A period of large states in north India, known for coins, temples and learning. The game uses it as a backdrop for the forge road.

events.label: The Iron Pillar of Delhi
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A tall wrought-iron pillar that has stayed free of heavy rust. Its date and its first location are debated. It is never shown in a way that copies a real inscription.

events.label: The Forge Road
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A smith's yard at night, a toppled cart of hot iron and a village's bridge nails to finish. The blade blocks a pole and cuts a rope, then goes back in its sheath. Keep the bellows going until dawn.

events.label: Aryabhata
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A mathematician and astronomer of the Gupta age. The date comes from general knowledge and was not checked here.

events.label: Nalanda
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A great centre of learning in eastern India. The founding date is as reported and was not checked here.

events.label: Brahmagupta and Zero
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: His text sets out rules for working with zero. This is the idea behind the traveller's shunya start. It is only a starting image in the game.

events.label: The Chola Age
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A south Indian empire known for temples and large irrigation works. Which tank and which century were not checked here.

events.label: The Tank and the Sluice
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A flood night at a delta tank, with a fouled sluice rope out of reach. Learn to hold a breath and send a line across with an arrow. Draw a stranded boat to shore.

events.label: The Brihadisvara Temple
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A great Chola temple at Thanjavur. The date comes from general knowledge and was not checked here.

events.label: Sultanate and Mughal Periods
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: Centuries of rule from Delhi and other courts, with new trade, building and art. The period is complex and is told here in neutral terms. It needs expert review.

events.label: Vijayanagara
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A southern empire with a capital at Hampi. The dates are as reported and were not checked here.

events.label: Independence of India
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: India became independent from British rule on this date. It was also the year of Partition, which caused great suffering. The game keeps this card factual and needs expert review.

events.label: The Lamp Road of the River Fair
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A great crowd walks a lamp-lit road beside a rising river, and fear spreads faster than the water. Use what you have learned, or better, put it down. This is the keystone of the Kali ring.
